```{r}
#| label: pkg_load
#| warning: false
#| message: false
source(here::here("_setup.R"))
box::use(
  wigits/utils[get_data, unnest_data],
  wigits/table[reactable_wrapdown],
)
```

```{r}
#| label: data_setup
dat <- get_data()
tool <- "sigs"
dat$data <- dat$data |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl(tool, .data$tool_parser))
dat$schemas <- dat$schemas |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$tool == {{ tool }})
```

## Allocation

```{r}
#| label: sigs_allocation
tbl_nm <- "sigs_allocation"
d <- dat$data |>
  unnest_data(tbl_nm, schemas_all = dat$schemas)
gt::gt(d$res)
```

## SNV counts

```{r}
#| label: sigs_snvcounts
tbl_nm <- "sigs_snvcounts"
d <- dat$data |>
  unnest_data(tbl_nm, schemas_all = dat$schemas)
d$res
```
